properties.title: Yellow Alert – Heat Watch Stage
properties.threshold_criteria: Heatwave persisted for 1 to 2 days; tolerable for general public but moderate risk for vulnerable cohorts.
properties.target_population: Infants, elderly (60+), outdoor informal workers, chronic illness patients
properties.recommended_actions: Public health advisories; hydration advisories; monitor Stevenson screen temperatures.
properties.section: Section 2: Early Warning Systems & Heat Alert Classifications
properties.label: HeatAdvisory

properties.title: Orange Alert – Heat Warning Stage
properties.threshold_criteria: Severe heatwave for 1 to 2 days or moderate heatwave for 3 to 4 days with high relative humidity.
properties.target_population: All outdoor workers, elderly, children, industrial workers
properties.recommended_actions: Activate municipal cooling centres; ban outdoor construction labor between 12 PM - 4 PM; distribute ORS; hospital heat stroke triage readiness.
properties.label: HeatAdvisory

properties.title: Red Alert – Extreme Heat Emergency
properties.threshold_criteria: Severe heatwave for >2 days or heatwave for >4 days. High risk of heat stroke and systemic organ failure.
properties.target_population: Entire urban population, with extreme peril for high-exposure slum settlements
properties.recommended_actions: Emergency operation centers active 24x7; mandatory cool refuge operations; free chilled water distribution along mass transit corridors.
properties.label: HeatAdvisory
